text: Trim EL — Estée Lauder is down 17% and 34% off its high with persistent selling pressure, so reduce your exposure before it gets worse.
Trim SGLP.L — it has the weakest relative strength in your entire portfolio at -99 and is down nearly 12%, meaning the market is actively rejecting this name.
Trim ONDS — three consecutive earnings misses, down 15%, and 34% off its high means the company keeps disappointing and the stock reflects it.
Add to MU — a PE of just 7.4 combined with 49% revenue growth is unusually cheap for that kind of momentum, making this pullback a good entry point.
Add to META — a PE of 16.9 with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow is a genuinely rare value-and-growth combo in big tech right now.
Buy VTR — this healthcare REIT scores a perfect 5.0 on the breakout screener with confirmed accumulation, and benefits from the easing rate environment.
